required_signals.description: Human-readable legacy signal vocabulary. Documentation only during the structured-predicate migration; not compact-mode grading authority.

forbidden_signals.description: Human-readable legacy signal vocabulary. Documentation only during the structured-predicate migration; not compact-mode grading authority.

measurement_status.description: Frozen by Phase A; updated by Phase D from receipt evidence. Allowed values: contract-only-not-executed (default), executed-pass, executed-gap, executed-unavailable.

phase_d_receipt_pointer.description: Optional pointer to the Phase D receipt entry that justifies this status. Required when measurement_status is not contract-only-not-executed; the validator cross-checks this against phase-d-receipt.json.

execution_layer.description: Optional declared execution layer. When present, names the layer that would be required to claim execution (e.g., pure_projection, mcp_bootstrap). Cases lacking this field remain contract-only by default.

fixture_intent.description: Whether this case tests lexical query relevance (and therefore requires the synthetic summary to contain the declared query vocabulary) or tests compact projection of a known source (and therefore uses canonical_ids).

case_notes.description: Optional human-readable note describing what this case proves and any non-obvious conditions (e.g., must request 107/108/109 to prove exclusion).

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. Empty pointer addresses the root document. Tilde escapes: ~0 -> ~, ~1 -> /. A token segment contains no unescaped `/` or bare `~`; only ~0, ~1, or non-tilde non-slash characters are valid.

value.description: Required for equals / includes / excludes; forbidden for exists / not_exists. The comparison target. Scalars match exactly; objects match recursively by partial match. Arrays are forbidden because the v1 contract uses object recursive partial-match rather than element-by-element array matching.
